items.name: Boot and install media
items.description: Make bootable USB drives and rescue media.
items.description_id: Buat drive USB bootable dan media penyelamat.
items.notes: Hiren's BootCD PE, Memtest86+ and the Windows 11 media page have no WinGet package, so they appear as manual steps.
items.notes_id: Hiren's BootCD PE, Memtest86+, dan halaman media Windows 11 tidak punya paket WinGet, sehingga muncul sebagai langkah manual.

items.name: Creative and media
items.description: Screen recording, video, audio and image tools.
items.description_id: Perekaman layar, video, audio, dan alat gambar.

items.name: Developer workstation
items.description: Git, an editor, language runtimes, a modern terminal and common tooling.
items.description_id: Git, editor, runtime bahasa, terminal modern, dan perkakas umum.

items.name: Hardware diagnostics
items.description: Identify components and test CPU, GPU, memory and storage.
items.description_id: Identifikasi komponen dan uji CPU, GPU, memori, dan penyimpanan.
items.notes: Memtest86+ is not a WinGet package; the script lists it as a manual step with its official page.
items.notes_id: Memtest86+ bukan paket WinGet; skrip mencantumkannya sebagai langkah manual beserta halaman resminya.

items.name: New PC basics
items.description: Browsers, office, PDF reader, media player, archiver and the runtimes many programs expect.
items.description_id: Peramban, perkantoran, pembaca PDF, pemutar media, pengarsip, dan runtime yang dibutuhkan banyak program.

items.name: Remote support kit
items.description: Remote desktop, secure shell and network tools.
items.description_id: Desktop jarak jauh, secure shell, dan alat jaringan.

items.name: Runtimes pack
items.description: Visual C++ redistributables, .NET desktop runtimes, WebView2 and DirectX.
items.description_id: Redistributable Visual C++, runtime desktop .NET, WebView2, dan DirectX.

items.name: Storage and recovery
items.description: Check disks, analyse space, recover partitions and files, and sync or back up data.
items.description_id: Periksa disk, analisis ruang, pulihkan partisi dan berkas, serta sinkronkan atau cadangkan data.

items.name: Technician essentials
items.description: A compact everyday kit for repair and support work: archiver, editor, file search, disk usage, SSH/SFTP and hardware info.
items.description_id: Perlengkapan ringkas sehari-hari untuk perbaikan dan dukungan: pengarsip, editor, pencarian berkas, penggunaan disk, SSH/SFTP, dan info perangkat keras.
